web.reason: ReDoS with crafted extglob patterns. Every published version (<=4.0.7) is affected and there is no fix yet. Only build and lint tooling match globs, with patterns from our own config, never user input.

mobile.reason: ReDoS with crafted extglob patterns. Every published version (<=4.0.7) is affected and there is no fix yet. Only Metro and the Expo CLI match globs at build time, with patterns from our own config.
Fixed only in zod 4.6.6, but @expo/cli requires zod ^3.25.76. It runs in the Expo CLI at build time and validates our own config, not untrusted input. Revisit when Expo moves to zod 4.

Quadratic decoding of malformed percent-encoded input. The fix (0.5.1) is ESM-only, and query-string 7 (pinned by expo-router) loads it with require, so an override would break routing. The worst case is a slow decode of a deep link on the user's own device. Revisit with the next expo-router upgrade.
